# TopVolk Construction LLC

> Licensed home renovation contractor in the Seattle, WA area. We design and build kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, decks, basement finishes, ADUs, and full home additions for King, Snohomish, Pierce, and Kitsap counties.

## Services

- [General Contracting](https://www.topvolk.org/services/general-contracting): full-service residential project management, permits, budget planning
- [Bathroom Remodel](https://www.topvolk.org/services/bathroom-remodel): tile, vanities, fixtures, plumbing updates, layout changes
- [Kitchen Remodel](https://www.topvolk.org/services/kitchen-remodel): cabinets, countertops, appliances, layout, backsplash
- [Deck Installation](https://www.topvolk.org/services/deck-installation): composite, cedar, pressure-treated; railings, pergolas, custom designs
- [Basement Finishing](https://www.topvolk.org/services/basement-finishing): framing, insulation, drywall, flooring, waterproofing
- [Home Additions](https://www.topvolk.org/services/home-additions): room additions, second-story builds, ADUs (HB 1337 compliant)

## Service Area (Seattle Metro)

We serve 56+ cities across four counties:

- King County: Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Renton, Kent, Auburn, Federal Way, Sammamish, Issaquah, Burien, Mercer Island, Newcastle, Tukwila, Shoreline, SeaTac, Maple Valley, Covington, Black Diamond, Carnation, Duvall, North Bend, Snoqualmie, Skykomish, Pacific, Algona, Medina, Clyde Hill, Hunts Point, Yarrow Point, Beaux Arts Village, Kenmore, Lake Forest Park, Bothell, Woodinville, Enumclaw, Milton
- Snohomish County: Everett, Lynnwood, Marysville, Edmonds, Mukilteo, Mill Creek, Bothell, Snohomish, Arlington, Stanwood, Monroe, Mountlake Terrace, Lake Stevens, Sultan
- Pierce County: Tacoma, Lakewood, Puyallup, University Place, Bonney Lake, Gig Harbor, Edgewood, Fircrest, Sumner, Orting, Steilacoom, DuPont, Buckley, Milton
- Kitsap County: Bremerton, Silverdale, Poulsbo, Bainbridge Island, Port Orchard

## Specialties for Pacific Northwest Climate

- Basement waterproofing for high-rainfall conditions (PNW)
- Deck materials chosen for Pacific Northwest moisture (composite, cedar, pressure-treated)
- Permit-driven projects in King County, Snohomish County, City of Seattle DCI
- Craftsman, mid-century, and modern home renovations
